scope: Clean-runtime recheck of the previously published JoyAI jitter-stable incumbent
summary: A fresh CPython 3.13 audit of the byte-identical published incumbent does not reproduce the earlier all-gates-pass conclusion; the unchanged spatial-chroma-TV gate fails, so the previous evidence statement is corrected rather than hidden.
evidence: The rechecked MP4 has the same SHA-256 a63237403e2b010444ad885277dd5b06f75370f9c4dcbde418732b641b3099a8 recorded by the earlier report.
The clean-runtime late spatial-chroma-TV mean is 9.794221, not the earlier saved 3.211909, against the same 5.981568 limit.
All other frozen image gates, late contact 11/11, persistent grasp 147/147, erasure rejection 147/147, and all four adversarial attacks pass in the recheck.
The challenger improves the same clean-runtime chroma diagnostic slightly to 9.746221 but does not pass it.
lessons: Saved metrics must be reproducible from a clean interpreter and fresh bytecode cache before being described as a passing promotion contract.
A correcting ledger record must supersede a previously optimistic conclusion when later evidence disagrees.
limitations: The exact historical source of the stale 3.211909 value is not proven; iCloud-dataless runtime and stale-cache behavior are the leading infrastructure explanation, not an established causal fact.
next_actions: Hash the executed audit modules and record interpreter/cache provenance in every future report.
Add a clean-runtime reproduction gate before demo promotion.
